build.description: Compile and bundle all apps and packages for production. Outputs land in dist/.

transit.description: A node with no script, so a task can depend on its dependencies' inputs without waiting for them to finish.

typecheck.description: Run tsc --noEmit across all packages. Types come from source, so packages check in parallel; `transit` keeps their inputs in the hash.

dev.description: Start all development servers with hot-reload. Runs persistently and is never cached.

test.description: Run unit and integration tests across packages.

check.description: A package's own checks. For @kirana-style/workspace: cargo fmt, Clippy, cargo-deny, Rust tests and Vitest.

coverage.description: Tests with coverage, which must stay at 100 % for the Kirana packages.

@kirana-style/compiler#build.description: Build the native Kirana engine for this platform. Rebuilt only when the Rust workspace changes.

@kirana-style/workspace#coverage.description: Rust and TypeScript coverage for the compiler; 100 % or it fails. Its dependencies' inputs reach the hash through `^build`.
